description: How much money the brand's Stripe PAYMENT LINKS made — the "what did the link in this ad earn" question. Paid purchases and revenue (MAJOR units, per currency) from completed checkouts between since and until (YYYY-MM-DD, default the last 30 days), for one paymentLinkId or every link. groupBy: link (default without an id — which link earned most), reference (default with an id — per ad, from the referenceId a taggedUrl carries), promotion_code, or day. For a subscription link only the first payment counts; renewals are in stripe_report. Says when the read is capped. Read-only, free. Needs Stripe connected (Connectors > Stripe, or connect_connector).

groupBy.description: link, reference, promotion_code or day; default link without paymentLinkId, reference with it

paymentLinkId.description: one payment link, plink_...; omit for every link

since.description: start date, YYYY-MM-DD; default 30 days before until

name: get_stripe_payment_link_revenue
title: stripe payment link revenue
